+---
+module: icx_logging
+version_added: "2.9"
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX switches
+author: Ruckus Wireless (@Commscope)
+description:
+  - Configure logging destinations and the syslog facility on ICX 7000 switches.
+options:
+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination or global logging switch.
+    choices: [host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, on]
+    type: str
+  name:
+    description: Host name or IPv4/IPv6 address for a host destination.
+    type: str
+  udp_port:
+    description: UDP port for a host destination.
+    type: str
+  facility:
+    description: Syslog facility. Use state absent to clear it.
+    type: str
+  level:
+    description: Logging severity. Required for buffered destinations.
+    type: str
+    choices: [alerts, critical, debugging, emergencies, errors, informational, notifications, warnings]
+  aggregate:
+    description: List of logging definitions to manage together.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+  state:
+    description: Desired state.
+    choices: [present, absent]
+    default: present
+    type: str
+  check_running_config:
+    description: Compare with the running configuration before generating commands.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Add IPv6 syslog server and set facility
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - {dest: host, name: '2001:db8::1', udp_port: '514'}
+      - {facility: local7}
+
+- name: Disable buffered debugging
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: buffered
+    level: debugging
+    state: absent
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands sent to the switch.
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+  sample: ['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514']
+'''

+import re
+from copy import deepcopy
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule, env_fallback
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import validate_ip_v6_address
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config

+LEVELS = frozenset(('alerts', 'critical', 'debugging', 'emergencies', 'errors',
+                    'informational', 'notifications', 'warnings'))
+DESTINATIONS = ('host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'on')
+
+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    if param is None:
+        param = check
+    return sum(check.get(key) is not None for key in param)
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for item in lst:
+        if item.get('name') == name:
+            return item
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    return set(want) - set(have), set(have) - set(want)
+
+
+def check_required_if(module, spec, param):
+    for key, value, required in spec or ():
+        if param.get(key) == value:
+            for field in required:
+                if param.get(field) is None or param.get(field) == '':
+                    module.fail_json(msg='%s is required when %s is %s' % (field, key, value))
+
+
+def parse_port(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.match(r'^logging host (?:ipv6 )?\S+\s+udp-port\s+(\d+)(?:\s|$)', line.strip())
+        if match:
+            return match.group(1)
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_name(line, dest):

+        match = re.match(r'^logging host (?:ipv6 )?(\S+)(?:\s|$)', line.strip())
+        if match:
+            return match.group(1)

+
+

+    return dest == 'host' and re.match(r'^logging host ipv6 \S+(?:\s|$)', line.strip()) is not None

+def map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=None):

+    entries = params.get('aggregate')
+    if entries is None:
+        entries = [params]
+    result = []
+    for entry in entries:

+            module.fail_json(msg='invalid logging destination: %s' % item['dest'])
+        if item['level'] is not None and item['level'] not in LEVELS:
+            module.fail_json(msg='invalid logging level: %s' % item['level'])

+                module.fail_json(msg='udp_port must be between 1 and 65535')

+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    if not module.params.get('check_running_config', True):
+        return [dict(dest='_unchecked')]

+    result = []
+    facility = 'user'
+    enabled_levels = set()
+    disabled_levels = set()
+    buffered = False
+    global_off = False

+                               addr6=parse_address(line, 'host')))
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split()[2]
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = 'user'
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffered = True
+        elif re.match(r'^logging buffered (\S+)$', line):
+            level = line.split()[2]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                enabled_levels.add(level)
+        elif re.match(r'^no logging buffered (\S+)$', line):
+            level = line.split()[3]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                disabled_levels.add(level)

+            if level in LEVELS:
+                result.append(dict(dest='console', name=None, level=level))

+            dest = 'rfc5424' if line == 'logging enable rfc5424' else line.split()[1]

+        elif line in ('no logging console', 'no logging persistence', 'no logging enable rfc5424'):
+            dest = 'rfc5424' if line == 'no logging enable rfc5424' else line.split()[2]
+            result[:] = [item for item in result if item['dest'] != dest]
+    if buffered or enabled_levels or disabled_levels:
+        levels = (set(LEVELS) if buffered else enabled_levels) - disabled_levels
+        result.append(dict(dest='buffered', name=None, level=levels))
+    result.append(dict(dest='facility', name=None, facility=facility))
+    if not global_off and not any(item['dest'] == 'on' for item in result):
+        result.append(dict(dest='on', name=None))
+    return result
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    unchecked = any(item['dest'] == '_unchecked' for item in have)
+    facility = next((item.get('facility') for item in have if item['dest'] == 'facility'), 'user')
+    for item in want:
+        dest, state = item['dest'], item['state']
+        desired_facility = item.get('facility')
+        if desired_facility is not None:
+            if state == 'present' and desired_facility != facility:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % desired_facility)
+                facility = desired_facility
+            elif state == 'absent' and (unchecked or (facility != 'user' and desired_facility == facility)):
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+                facility = 'user'
+        if dest is None:
+            continue
+        if dest == 'host':
+            matches = [old for old in have if old['dest'] == 'host' and old['name'] == item['name']
+                       and old.get('addr6', False) == item['addr6']]
+            if state == 'absent':
+                if unchecked:
+                    commands.append(_host_command(item, remove=True))
+                for old in matches:
+                    if item['udp_port'] is None or item['udp_port'] == old.get('udp_port'):
+                        commands.append(_host_command(old, remove=True))
+                        have.remove(old)
+            elif not any(old.get('udp_port') == item['udp_port'] for old in matches):
+                # A host with another port must be replaced to reach the requested state.
+                for old in matches:
+                    commands.append(_host_command(old, remove=True))
+                    have.remove(old)
+                commands.append(_host_command(item))
+                have.append(item)
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            old = next((entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == dest), None)
+            levels = set(old['level']) if old else set()
+            target = set(item['level'])
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(target, levels)
+                for level in sorted(adds):
+                    commands.append('logging buffered %s' % level)
+                levels.update(adds)
+            else:
+                _, removes = diff_in_list(levels - target, levels)
+                if unchecked:
+                    removes = target
+                for level in sorted(removes):
+                    commands.append('no logging buffered %s' % level)
+                levels.difference_update(removes)
+            if old:
+                old['level'] = levels
+            else:
+                have.append(dict(dest=dest, level=levels))
+        else:
+            old = next((entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == dest), None)
+            present = old is not None
+            cmd = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging %s' % dest
+            if dest == 'console' and item.get('level'):
+                cmd += ' %s' % item['level']
+            if state == 'present' and (not present or
+                                       (dest == 'console' and item.get('level') and
+                                        old.get('level') != item['level'])):
+                commands.append(cmd)
+                if old:
+                    old['level'] = item.get('level')
+                else:
+                    have.append(dict(dest=dest, level=item.get('level')))
+            elif state == 'absent' and (present or unchecked):
+                commands.append('no ' + cmd)
+                have[:] = [old for old in have if old['dest'] != dest]
+    return commands
+
+
+def _host_command(item, remove=False):
+    command = 'logging host %s%s' % ('ipv6 ' if item.get('addr6') else '', item['name'])
+    if item.get('udp_port') is not None:
+        command += ' udp-port %s' % item['udp_port']
+    return ('no ' if remove else '') + command
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(dest=dict(type='str', choices=list(DESTINATIONS)),
+                        name=dict(type='str'), udp_port=dict(type='str'),
+                        facility=dict(type='str'), level=dict(type='str', choices=sorted(LEVELS)),
+                        state=dict(type='str', default='present', choices=['present', 'absent']))
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    aggregate_spec['state'].pop('default')
+    argument_spec = dict(aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+                         check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                             fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+
+    def test_host_port_change(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port='1514'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514',
+                                                     'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 1514'])
+

+

+    def test_console_level_and_unchecked_removals(self):

+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',

+        check_required_if(module, required_if or [('dest', 'host', ['name']),
+                                                  ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])], item)
+        if item['dest'] is None and item['facility'] is None:
+            module.fail_json(msg='dest or facility is required')
+        if item['dest'] is not None and item['dest'] not in DESTINATIONS:
+            module.fail_json(msg='invalid logging destination: %s' % item['dest'])
+        if item['level'] is not None and item['level'] not in LEVELS:
+            module.fail_json(msg='invalid logging level: %s' % item['level'])
+        if item['udp_port'] is not None:
+            try:
+                port = int(item['udp_port'])
+            except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                module.fail_json(msg='udp_port must be between 1 and 65535')
+            if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
+                module.fail_json(msg='udp_port must be between 1 and 65535')
+            item['udp_port'] = str(port)
+        item['addr6'] = bool(item['dest'] == 'host' and validate_ip_v6_address(item['name']))
+        if item['dest'] != 'host':
+            item['name'] = None
+            item['udp_port'] = None
+        if item['dest'] == 'buffered':
+            item['level'] = set([item['level']])
+        result.append(item)
+    return result
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    if not module.params.get('check_running_config', True):
+        return [dict(dest='_unchecked')]
+    data = get_config(module, flags=['| include logging'], compare=True) or ''
+    result = []
+    facility = 'user'
+    enabled_levels = set()
+    disabled_levels = set()
+    buffered = False
+    global_off = False
+    for raw in data.splitlines():
+        line = raw.strip()
+        if line == 'no logging on':
+            global_off = True
+        elif line == 'logging on':
+            global_off = False
+        elif line.startswith('logging host '):
+            result.append(dict(dest='host', name=parse_name(line, 'host'),
+                               udp_port=parse_port(line, 'host'),
+                               addr6=parse_address(line, 'host')))
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split()[2]
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = 'user'
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffered = True
+        elif re.match(r'^logging buffered (\S+)$', line):
+            level = line.split()[2]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                enabled_levels.add(level)
+        elif re.match(r'^no logging buffered (\S+)$', line):
+            level = line.split()[3]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                disabled_levels.add(level)
+        elif re.match(r'^logging console (\S+)$', line):
+            level = line.split()[2]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                result.append(dict(dest='console', name=None, level=level))
+        elif line in ('logging console', 'logging persistence', 'logging enable rfc5424'):
+            dest = 'rfc5424' if line == 'logging enable rfc5424' else line.split()[1]
+            result.append(dict(dest=dest, name=None))
+        elif line in ('no logging console', 'no logging persistence', 'no logging enable rfc5424'):
+            dest = 'rfc5424' if line == 'no logging enable rfc5424' else line.split()[2]
+            result[:] = [item for item in result if item['dest'] != dest]
+    if buffered or enabled_levels or disabled_levels:
+        levels = (set(LEVELS) if buffered else enabled_levels) - disabled_levels
+        result.append(dict(dest='buffered', name=None, level=levels))
+    result.append(dict(dest='facility', name=None, facility=facility))
+    if not global_off and not any(item['dest'] == 'on' for item in result):
+        result.append(dict(dest='on', name=None))
+    return result
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    unchecked = any(item['dest'] == '_unchecked' for item in have)
+    facility = next((item.get('facility') for item in have if item['dest'] == 'facility'), 'user')
+    for item in want:
+        dest, state = item['dest'], item['state']
+        desired_facility = item.get('facility')
+        if desired_facility is not None:
+            if state == 'present' and desired_facility != facility:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % desired_facility)
+                facility = desired_facility
+            elif state == 'absent' and (unchecked or (facility != 'user' and desired_facility == facility)):
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+                facility = 'user'
+        if dest is None:
+            continue
+        if dest == 'host':
+            matches = [old for old in have if old['dest'] == 'host' and old['name'] == item['name']
+                       and old.get('addr6', False) == item['addr6']]
+            if state == 'absent':
+                if unchecked:
+                    commands.append(_host_command(item, remove=True))
+                for old in matches:
+                    if item['udp_port'] is None or item['udp_port'] == old.get('udp_port'):
+                        commands.append(_host_command(old, remove=True))
+                        have.remove(old)
+            elif not any(old.get('udp_port') == item['udp_port'] for old in matches):
+                # A host with another port must be replaced to reach the requested state.
+                for old in matches:
+                    commands.append(_host_command(old, remove=True))
+                    have.remove(old)
+                commands.append(_host_command(item))
+                have.append(item)
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            old = next((entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == dest), None)
+            levels = set(old['level']) if old else set()
+            target = set(item['level'])
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(target, levels)
+                for level in sorted(adds):
+                    commands.append('logging buffered %s' % level)
+                levels.update(adds)
+            else:
+                _, removes = diff_in_list(levels - target, levels)
+                if unchecked:
+                    removes = target
+                for level in sorted(removes):
+                    commands.append('no logging buffered %s' % level)
+                levels.difference_update(removes)
+            if old:
+                old['level'] = levels
+            else:
+                have.append(dict(dest=dest, level=levels))
+        else:
+            old = next((entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == dest), None)
+            present = old is not None
+            cmd = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging %s' % dest
+            if dest == 'console' and item.get('level'):
+                cmd += ' %s' % item['level']
+            if state == 'present' and (not present or
+                                       (dest == 'console' and item.get('level') and
+                                        old.get('level') != item['level'])):
+                commands.append(cmd)
+                if old:
+                    old['level'] = item.get('level')
+                else:
+                    have.append(dict(dest=dest, level=item.get('level')))
+            elif state == 'absent' and (present or unchecked):
+                commands.append('no ' + cmd)
+                have[:] = [old for old in have if old['dest'] != dest]
+    return commands
+
+
+def _host_command(item, remove=False):
+    command = 'logging host %s%s' % ('ipv6 ' if item.get('addr6') else '', item['name'])
+    if item.get('udp_port') is not None:
+        command += ' udp-port %s' % item['udp_port']
+    return ('no ' if remove else '') + command
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(dest=dict(type='str', choices=list(DESTINATIONS)),
+                        name=dict(type='str'), udp_port=dict(type='str'),
+                        facility=dict(type='str'), level=dict(type='str', choices=sorted(LEVELS)),
+                        state=dict(type='str', default='present', choices=['present', 'absent']))
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    aggregate_spec['state'].pop('default')
+    argument_spec = dict(aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+                         check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                             fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+    def test_console_level_and_unchecked_removals(self):
